content.query:
-- read a csv file from adls container

SELECT
*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://quantcloudstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/quant-container/Raw/players.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
) AS ROWS;


SELECT
player_id, first_name
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://quantcloudstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/quant-container/Raw/players.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
) AS ROWS;
